0022600119.text: The Hornets, who are 2-1 overall and 1-1 at home, host the 2-1 Wizards in their fourth game of the season, with Charlotte sitting 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East while Washington is 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), and Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently beating the Wizards 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026.
